content.narrative_significance: This phase's target, bathhouse_arrival, emerged from PHASE-339's closing record with bathhouse_arrival ALONE at the top, pool 14, no tie this time — bridge_crossing, no_face_loneliness, river_spirit_departure, and train_memory_scene sat lower, four-way tied at 13. Since bathhouse_arrival is the sole largest pool, it is this phase's target with no tie-break needed. A registry-confirmed reuse-candidate search performed before this phase's authoring found only 9 usable candidates for bathhouse_arrival (the smallest reuse pool this arc has seen so far, but not zero, so no STOP was required); the lowest, tunnel_threshold_0226, was checked against the used-as-a-leg-anywhere set FIRST (per explicit instruction) and confirmed already a leg once (payoff in chain_crossing_fifty_first_confirmed under bridge_crossing), reused here citing its real, uncited bathhouse_arrival tag. This chain, named 'fifty_sixth_confirmed' extending the established chain_arrival_* naming discipline, gives bathhouse_arrival its fifty-sixth dedicated real chain (of its 55 predecessors, 53 carry the chain_arrival_* name — including its own early non-ordinal sub-name chain_arrival_fourth_time — and 2, chain_threshold_completed and chain_threshold_echo, are fully differently-named early-era legacy chains — unlike every other anchor, which has at most one such legacy name, bathhouse_arrival has two; all three count identically toward the ordinal). FULL cross-anchor payoff-pool accounting, correctly distinguishing the plant's REUSE (already-excluded, no additional reduction) from the payoff's GENUINELY NEW consumption, per the same discipline PHASE-237 through PHASE-339 established: bathhouse_arrival itself drops by only ONE, not two (14 -> 13); bridge_crossing drops by one because the payoff scene carries a real bridge_crossing tag (13 -> 12), a cross-anchor reduction from the PAYOFF leg only; no_face_loneliness (13), river_spirit_departure (13), and train_memory_scene (13) are unaffected by this leg's own tags. Full record after this phase, RECONFIRMED BY A DIRECT POST-PHASE RECOUNT: bathhouse_arrival 13 (this phase's target), bridge_crossing 12 (cross-anchor), no_face_loneliness 13, river_spirit_departure 13, train_memory_scene 13. New top tier: a FOUR-WAY TIE at 13 among bathhouse_arrival, no_face_loneliness, river_spirit_departure, and train_memory_scene; bridge_crossing sits lowest, alone at 12. Next priority by the largest-pool convention, primary tie-break (fewest dedicated real chains) applied among the four: bathhouse_arrival=56, no_face_loneliness=48, river_spirit_departure=50, train_memory_scene=42 — train_memory_scene is the sole fewest, so it is next priority.
